candidates.title: LeanStream: A Speculate-and-Refine Streaming Framework for Efficient on-Device LLM Inference
candidates.reason: Storage-I/O-centric on-device inference system for models exceeding DRAM. Progressively refines compute/loading/cache-retention priorities from partial GPU results to overlap GPU execution with SSD/Flash I/O; reports 4.8x-7.5x lower memory use at prior-best throughput and an additional 1.6x-2.1x token-throughput improvement.

candidates.title: A Measurement Study of LLM Inference Trade-offs Across Edge Continuum Hardware
candidates.reason: Controlled systems measurement across Jetson edge and near-edge CPU/GPU nodes, covering latency, model footprint, energy, and quality trade-offs. Useful empirical boundary data for heterogeneous/local inference design rather than a new serving mechanism.
